subject: PI function
notes: 15.73.3 r1 with its precondition established by 8.8.1.3 (no ARITHMETIC clause = native): the returned value minus the rule's OWN written expression vanishes at scale 9, its integer part is 3, it lies strictly between 3 and 4, and it MOVEs to a PIC 9.9(5) receiver as 3.14159 -- the fixed half of the rule asserted, the implementor-defined accuracy half read from the implementor's own A.1 item 92 documentation.
